description:
Hushfacebook v0.10.0 targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This release brings 87 patches, up from 86. The new one is Unlock app icons, which lets you pick any icon on Facebook's App icon page. New switches add a Watch history shortcut, keep a reel's time above its progress bar, stop link history in Facebook's browser and hold back camera roll processing. Saves whose only sound is xHE-AAC now get sound most players can play, and the release notes map each reported issue this release touches.

Validation: 2418 runtime tests passed locally. All 870 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 87 patches applied to Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, build 475417104, or its 32-bit build 475417036. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
